usage.guide: Do not use. This Orbis proxy endpoint is broken: a POST to https://orbisapi.com/proxy/pdf-sign-api-f3d620 returns HTTP 404 with {"error":"API_NOT_FOUND","message":"No active API found with slug 'pdf-sign-api-f3d620'."}. The proxy slug is no longer active, so no PDF signing can occur and no useful result is returned. No payment is taken (the 402 pre-flight is misleading). Skip this service for document signing.

name: Agentstools Notarize
description: Notarizes a public URL: the service fetches it server-side and returns a signed snapshot (final URL, HTTP status, content-type, sha256 of the body, server timestamp, upstream host) with two cryptographic attestations — a plain EIP-712 signature and an EAS off-chain attestation — proving integrity, timestamp and non-repudiation of what the endpoint observed at fetch time.

url.description: Public http(s) URL to fetch and notarize. REQUIRED. Passed as a query param.

mode.description: hash = metadata + sha256 only (default); full = also return the fetched body (base64).

sha256.description: 0x-prefixed sha256 of the fetched response body.

fetched_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the service fetched the URL.

attestor.description: Ethereum address of the attestor key that signed the snapshot.

eip712.description: EIP-712 typed-data signature over the snapshot (domain, primaryType Snapshot, types, message, signature, signer, schemaString).

eas_offchain.description: EAS off-chain (version 2) attestation (uid, signer, sig{domain, types, message, signature}) verifiable on easscan.org or via the EAS SDK.

verify_hint.description: How to verify each attestation (POST /attest/verify, POST /crypto/verify, or easscan.org / EAS SDK).

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/notarize?url=<public-http(s)-url>[&mode=hash|full] — inputs are query params, no request body; only `url` is required (mode defaults to hash). Result is inline in the 200 body (synchronous, no poll). Pays $0.008 USDC via x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453), keyless. NOTE: send requests over HTTP/1.1 — the host's HTTP/2 (h2) upgrade hangs; Node fetch/undici and forced-http1.1 curl both work.
usage.outputShape: mode (hash|full), snapshot{requested_url, final_url, http_status, content_type, content_length, sha256 (0x-prefixed sha256 of the body), fetched_at (ISO-8601 UTC), upstream_host, truncated}, attestor (0x attestor address), attestations{eip712{domain{name:'AgentsTools Attestation',version,chainId:8453}, primaryType:'Snapshot', types, message, signature, signer, schemaString}, eas_offchain{standard:'eas-offchain', version:2, uid, signer, sig{domain(EAS 1.3.0 @ 0x4200...0021), types, message, signature}}}, verify_hint{eip712, eas_offchain, self}, disclaimer.
quirks: `url` is the ONLY required input, passed as a query param on a GET (no request body). `mode` defaults to `hash` (metadata + sha256 only); `mode=full` also returns the fetched body base64-encoded. `network` is reserved (attestations are always Base/chainId 8453).

IMPORTANT transport quirk: the host hangs on HTTP/2 (curl's default h2 negotiation times out with no response). Force HTTP/1.1 (curl --http1.1) or use a client that defaults to HTTP/1.1 (Node fetch/undici) — then it responds normally with a fast 402/200.

Two attestations are returned: an EIP-712 signature (domain 'AgentsTools Attestation' v1, chainId 8453, primaryType Snapshot) and an EAS off-chain v2 attestation (verifiable on easscan.org or with the EAS SDK). verify_hint points to the companion POST /attest/verify (pure-compute recover) and POST /crypto/verify.

Provider disclaimer: this proves integrity + timestamp + non-repudiation of what THIS service observed at fetch time — signed by the attestor key. It is NOT a trustless proof of the origin server (that would require zkTLS / web-proof).

Verified live 2026-08-07: url=https://example.com, mode=hash -> http_status 200, content_type text/html, content_length 559, sha256 0xff67a9d764d6a2367a187734e697f6a53217db9a21c101d410a113ca871a299d, attestor 0x48Cbbbf38Bae6394B0D921Fa8c00d4A90e088960; $0.008 charged, tx 0xe57e9d5d39ee3db590a62a58eb896bc25b0c90bf2e21d8474b4de45afe9672a2 on Base.
usage.guide: Notarize a public web URL with a single keyless x402 GET. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/notarize?url=<public http(s) URL> (required) plus optional mode=hash (default; metadata + sha256 only) or mode=full (also returns the fetched body base64). No request body. Pays $0.008 USDC via x402 on Base. Synchronous — the 200 body carries snapshot{final_url, http_status, content_type, content_length, sha256, fetched_at, upstream_host} plus two attestations: an EIP-712 signature and an EAS off-chain (v2) attestation, both from the service's attestor key, so the response is later verifiable (POST /attest/verify, POST /crypto/verify, or easscan.org / EAS SDK). Proves integrity + timestamp + non-repudiation of what the endpoint observed at fetch time — not a trustless proof of the origin server. Transport quirk: use HTTP/1.1 (the host hangs on HTTP/2).
